notes.title: Patch note : Version 0.7.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Rework ⚙️[/h1]
- [b]Incendiary and electricity modules:[/b] damage is now more evenly distributed over time.
- [b]Bounce Module:[/b] from now on, the bounce effect has a percentage chance of being applied to the projectile.
- [b]Smasher:[/b] the blast area from the explosion module has been rebalanced.
- [b]Kraken:[/b] the alien hit points has been rebalanced.

[h1]Bug fixes ⚒️[/h1] 
- [b]Kraken:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused the player to die when using a special skill against the Kraken.
- [b]Kraken:[/b] Fixed a bug that prevented the player from playing a new game after killing the Kraken.
- [b]Gravity Module:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused aliens to leave the game area.
- [b]Options:[/b] Fixed a bug that did not apply sound option changes correctly.
- [b]Meta Progression:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused the player's meta-progression to reset.
- [b]Endless mode:[/b] Fixed a bug that prevented the penalties to apply correctly.
- [b]Endless mode:[/b] Add the following penalties: fire resistance, electrical resistance, corrosive rain

[h1]New features⭐️[/h1]
- Added a timer to the infinite mode.

notes.title: THE LAST HUMAN IS A BIKER is out!
notes.notes:
EARLY ACCESS RELEASE - VERSION 0.7.2

[b]List of new features in the Early Access Version[/b]

- A brand new game mode: [b]Endless mode[/b]
This is a never-ending mode with waves of random aliens and penalty that make the game more and more difficult. To spice things up, elite aliens occasionally attack the player.

- [b]Leaderboards[/b]: Both game modes have their own online leaderboard (linked to the player's steam account). Players can now try hard for top 1.

- A new upgrade module: [b]Gravity[/b]
Draws all aliens in range into a wormhole. 

- A new upgrade module: [b]Efficiency[/b]
Slightly increases all weapon stats.

- [b]The Special Skills[/b] have been redesigned to have more impact in the game.

- [b]Driving 2.0[/b]: Character behavior has been reworked to give them more handling.

- [b]Tutorials[/b]: At the start of the first game, you will see tutorial interfaces to introduce you to the main mechanics of the game. You can disable them in the options menu.

- [b]Full control with the controller[/b]: the game is now 100% playable with the controller (improved menu navigation)

- [b]Auto-fire mode[/b]: for the lazy ones, an auto-fire mode is available in the options menu.

- [b]General rework and balancing[/b] of weapon modules
